items.name: Glob
items.summary: Glob represents a single glob in an override matcher.

items.name: Override
items.summary: Manages a set of overrides provided explicitly by the end user.

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: Returns an empty matcher that never matches any file path.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this matcher is empty.

methods.name: matched
methods.signature: fn matched<'a, P: AsRef<Path>>(&'a self, path: P, is_dir: bool) -> Match<Glob<'a>>
methods.summary: Returns whether the given file path matched a pattern in this override matcher.

methods.name: num_ignores
methods.summary: Returns the total number of ignore globs.

methods.name: num_whitelists
methods.summary: Returns the total number of whitelisted globs.

methods.name: path
methods.summary: Returns the directory of this override set.

items.name: OverrideBuilder
items.summary: Builds a matcher for a set of glob overrides.

methods.name: add
methods.signature: fn add(&mut self, glob: &str) -> Result<&mut OverrideBuilder, Error>
methods.summary: Add a glob to the set of overrides.

methods.name: allow_unclosed_class
methods.signature: fn allow_unclosed_class(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut OverrideBuilder
methods.summary: Toggle whether unclosed character classes are allowed. When allowed, a `[` without a matching `]` is treated literally instead of resulting in a parse error.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Builds a new override matcher from the globs added so far.

methods.name: case_insensitive
methods.signature: fn case_insensitive(&mut self, yes: bool) -> Result<&mut OverrideBuilder, Error>
methods.summary: Toggle whether the globs should be matched case insensitively or not.
